name: 92371 · Phelan, CA
findings: ZIP 92371 (Phelan) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (18%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92371 (Phelan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92371 (Phelan) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).
